description: An edit proposed to a page of a notebook here, for the user to accept or reject: old_text replaced with new_text, nothing written to the page. old_text is found once (or the one nearest near) in the page as it reads with the edits waiting on it applied; an empty one adds new_text at the page's end. Text one of those edits puts in or replaces: that edit is revised to take this in (any others it reaches taken back), and is by by now. Answered with edit.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

notebook.description: The notebook: its id, or its name (any case).

page.description: The page: its name (Parent:Child for one under another), any case, or its own name past its parents'.

old_text.description: The text it replaces, as the page has it; empty or left out: added at the page's end.

near.description: A place in the page's text: of old_text there more than once, the one nearest it (a passage selected, say).

by.description: Who's proposing it, by name (Meta, an agent's own name): kept with the edit, and shown with it.
